  FROM ports p

  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id

    SELECT p2.id, AVG(p2.standard_attr_id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY b2.vif_type

    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.port_id) AS port_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.vif_type) AS distinct_vif_type_count,
    AVG(pm.windowed_avg_std_attr_id) AS avg_windowed_std_attr_id
  FROM port_metrics pm
  GROUP BY pm.network_id
),
avg_port_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(npa.port_count) AS avg_port_count
  FROM network_port_aggregates npa
  JOIN active_networks an ON an.network_id = npa.network_id
)
SELECT
  an.network_id,
  an.network_name,
  an.admin_state_up,
  an.mtu,
  an.standard_attr_updated_at,
  an.network_row_num,
  npa.port_count,
  npa.distinct_vif_type_count,
  npa.avg_windowed_std_attr_id
FROM active_networks an
JOIN network_port_aggregates npa ON npa.network_id = an.network_id
CROSS JOIN avg_port_count apc
WHERE npa.port_count > apc.avg_port_count
ORDER BY npa.port_count DESC
